evals.expected_output: Runs actionlint and zizmor when available, walks the security checklist (permissions, SHA pinning, template injection, pull_request_target, OIDC, secrets), and reports findings as errors then warns with file/line/reason. Makes no file edits and offers kerpo-gha-workflow-refactor for fixes.

Produces a report-only audit grounded in the kerpo security baseline, distinguishes true errors from hardening warns, and notes that a clean actionlint does not imply security. Does not modify workflows.
